negative_findings.description: SZRB has no separate English investor-relations section comparable to a listed bank; disclosures observed are Slovak-first. EXIMBANKA SR is the exception, publishing bilingual sk/en annual reports and an /en/ document tree.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only searching would surface EXIMBANKA PDFs but would largely miss SZRB, SIH and Slovenská konsolidačná disclosures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms local-language collection is mandatory for this cell; an English-only pipeline would under-cover the state-owned perimeter.

negative_findings.description: rokovania.gov.sk serves document attachments through opaque endpoints (download.dat?id=<GUID pair>) and negotiation ids (/RVL/Negotiation/<n>) rather than stable per-report URLs; older material sits on separate subdomains (hsr.rokovania.sk, lrv.rokovania.sk).
negative_findings.result_summary: No stable, guessable permalink scheme for tabled sector reports was identified from search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector must resolve agenda pages first and cannot rely on deep-linking; link rot risk is high, so attachments should be mirrored on capture.

negative_findings.description: MH Invest s.r.o., MH Investment s.r.o., MH Manažment and Slovenský investičný holding s.r.o. are distinct entities easily confused with Slovak Investment Holding, a. s. (formerly SZRB Asset Management); several are industrial-park/asset vehicles under the Ministry of Economy rather than financial-sector actors.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search on 'MH Invest' returns at least four different IČO-level entities; only Slovak Investment Holding a.s. is squarely in scope for banking/payments intelligence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive name-based collection would ingest irrelevant industrial-park financials; collection must be keyed on IČO, not name.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice were obtained from search-result metadata; no fetch was performed to confirm reachability or current content.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must confirm liveness; treat any 403/timeout as bot defence rather than a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement notices of the state financial entities (Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie / Vestník verejného obstarávania) were not searched in this pass, although they are the richest indirect channel for IT, self-service and payments-hardware demand from SZRB, EXIMBANKA and Slovenská konsolidačná.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sk-language pass on uvo.gov.sk (vestník, profil verejného obstarávateľa) per entity IČO and add resulting sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Other public-interest financial actors were not covered: Slovenská pošta / Poštová banka relationship, Slovenská sporiteľňa's public-sector role, Štátna pokladnica (pokladnica.sk), Agentúra pre riadenie dlhu a likvidity (ARDAL), and the Ministry of Economy's own state vehicles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to Štátna pokladnica and ARDAL, which run state payment and treasury infrastructure directly relevant to payments intelligence.

coverage_gaps.description: Back-catalogue depth was confirmed for EXIMBANKA (reports linked back to 2006) but not established for SZRB, SIH or Slovenská konsolidačná beyond recent years on their own sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use registeruz.sk per-IČO filing history and web.archive.org snapshots to establish full multi-year series for each entity.

coverage_gaps.description: No Hungarian- or German-language channels were sought; these are unlikely to matter for SK state-entity disclosure but were not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deprioritise unless a cross-border export-finance angle (EXIMBANKA partner ECAs) becomes relevant.

brief: Slovakia's state-owned financial perimeter discloses on three parallel routes: the entities' own Slovak-first websites (SZRB, EXIMBANKA SR — the only reliably bilingual one — SIH, Slovenská konsolidačná), the statutory filing and ownership machinery (registeruz.sk per IČO, obchodný register, MF SR's shareholder-rights index and Súhrnná výročná správa SR), and the political reporting duty channel (rokovania.gov.sk government agendas, NR SR parlamentné tlače, NKÚ SR audit findings). The political route is the differentiator: NKÚ control reports and tabled sector reports expose process, systems and receivables detail that no annual report contains, and CRZ contract publication exposes the vendors behind these institutions. Collection should be keyed on IČO rather than name — 'MH Invest'-style name collisions are common — and government attachment URLs are unstable, so documents must be mirrored on capture. Local-language search was essential: English queries reach EXIMBANKA PDFs but effectively miss SZRB, SIH and the government portals.
